cost_view_rule: One material run emits both 1x and 2x central-cost views from the same target and fill path; doubled cost is never a second trial.
read_discipline: Do not read, reinterpret, or use any later controlled or neighboring result to compensate for a failed no-control pivot reference.

registration_prerequisite.condition: Serialized synthetic and organizer validation passes; independent review approves the exact executable set; the new family, A5 executable-source manifest, semantic review, score manifest, source hashes, trial opt-in, and A7 package rebind are materialized in their required order.

hard_alpha_minima.sleeve_activity_and_exposure: both sleeves pass every frozen minimum

stages.required_outcome: Every no-control broad-alpha minimum and every separately declared A5 score-evidence gate passes; any failure is terminal for this family.

stages.activation: only after the no-control material result and non-material A5 diagnostic are both terminal
stages.required_outcome: Apply all no-control PnL and score-evidence gates together. Passing permits a separately documented future stability plan; failure stops Team 06 with no control rescue.

terminal_rule: A failed no-control PnL, regime, role, sleeve, fold, quarter, concentration, coverage, or IC gate rejects the family. No stop, volatility target, drawdown brake, turnover cap, neighbor, or private ticket can compensate.
